summary.text: Andre Johnson is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 34A, in Harford County, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Army veteran and former police officer and county councilmember, he has served in the House since January 2023.

paragraphs.text: Johnson was born at Aberdeen Proving Ground and graduated from Edgewood High School in 1989.

He served in the U.S. Army as an armored crewman, worked as a special investigator for Baltimore City's Department of Housing and Community Development, and was a Baltimore City police officer and later worked at the Harford County Sheriff's Office.
Johnson represented District A on the Harford County Council from 2018 to 2022 and was elected to the House of Delegates in November 2022.
He sits on the Economic Matters Committee, where he chairs the Unemployment Insurance Subcommittee.
He has also served on the Maryland Military Installation Council since 2023 and has coached football and girls' basketball at Patterson Mill High School.
